description: Creates or updates marketing campaigns, matched by ItemId. A new campaign is always a draft, and a campaign that is scheduled or sending is left as it is.

items.description: An email campaign to a segment.

ItemId.description: Optional unique identifier of the record. When it matches a stored record, that record is updated. Otherwise a new record is created under this identifier, so references to it from other entries and steps keep resolving.

Name.description: The name of the campaign. Only staff see it.

SegmentId.description: The ItemId of the segment the campaign goes to. Import the segments first.

Campaigns.description: The records to create, or to update when their ItemId matches a stored record.
